race.comment: TYUSIX (8) wasn't beaten far in a hot form race fresh then did a good job last time, finishing runner-up over 1569m on the Parks track. Goes well third run back and looks suited here with the claim. Expected to be in the finish. HARD LEAF (6) missed the placings two runs back then improved last start but found one better over 1400m at Morphettville Parks, beaten only half a length after being in contention on the bend. Expected to be in the finish again. PAGANINI (12) doesn't win very often but ran a nice race last time out over 1544m at this track, finishing second and beaten a head. Best figures measure up. Set to run well again. REGAL RIPPER (5) is unbeaten on the main track and shapes as a top chance again.
